paite: Huan zingsang ahong hih in, siampu liante, upate leh laigelhmite leh vaihawmte tengteng toh akihou ua, Jesu ahen ua, api ua, Pilat kiang ah apeta uhi.
heading: Pilat Ma A Jesu Pina / (Mat 27.1-2; 27.11-14; Luk 23.1-5; Joh 18.28-38)
english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

paite: Pilat in akiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia," chi in adong a, ama'n akiang ah, "Na gen bang in himah ing," chi in adawng hi.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

paite: Siampu liante'n thu tampi in ahek uhi.
english: The chief priests accused him of many things.

paite: Huchi in Pilat in adong nawn a, akiang ah, "Bangmah a dawng lou maw? Ngai in, ahon hekna uh tamdan!" achi hi.
english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

paite: Jesu'n bangmah in adawng kei; huchi in Pilat in lamdang asa mahmah hi.
english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

paite: Huan Pilat in ankuanglui ni in mi henta khat anget peuhmah uh apawtsak zel hi.
heading: Jesu Thah Dia Thutan Ahi / (Mat 27.15-26; Luk 23.13-25; Joh 18.39-19.6)
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

paite: Mi khat, Barabbas achih uh, ahelte lak ah hensa in a-om a, amah bel helna a pang leh tualthat ahi.
english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

paite: Mipite ahohtou ua, amau a dia ahihsak zel bang a hihsak ding in angen uhi.
english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

paite: Pilat in adawng a akiang uah, "Judate' Kumpipa hon khahsak leng na ut uhia?" achi hi.
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

paite: Siampu liante'n hazat ziak a paipih uh ahi, chih athei hi.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

paite: Himahleh siampu liante'n Barabbas pawtsak zawk ngen ding in mipite ahasuan uhi.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

paite: Huan Pilat in akiang uah, "Judate' Kumpipa achih uh bang ka lohta dia le?" chi in adong nawn hi.
english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

paite: Huan amau, “Kros ah kilhden in," chi in akikou nawn uhi.
english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

paite: Pilat in akiang uah, "Bang ding in maw? Bang ahihkhial a ahia?" achi hi. Himahleh amau, "Kilhden in," chi in akikou semsem uhi.
english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

paite: Huchi in Pilat in mipite hihlungkim ut in, Barabbas apawtsakta a; Jesu avuak zoh in kilhden ding in apeta hi.
english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

paite: Huan sepaihte'n inn huangsung kong lai, Praitoriam achih uah, amah apilut ua, apawl ua mi tengteng asamkhawm uhi.
heading: Sepaihte'n Jesu Nuihza bawlna In Anei Uh / (Mat 27.27-31; Joh 19.2-3)
english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

paite: Huchi in puan sandup asilhsak ua, linglukhu phan in akhusak uhi.
english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

paite: "Chibai, Judate' Kumpipa!" chi in chibai abuk uhi.
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

paite: Alu sialluang in akhen ua, chil aphih ua, khukdin in chibai abuk uhi.
english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

paite: Huan nuihza bawlna a azatzoh un, puan sandup ahawk ua, ama puan asilhsak nawn ua, kilhden ding in apikhia uhi.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

paite: Huan mi vialvak khat, Kurini khomi, Alexander leh Rufas pa, Simon, agam lam a kipan hong pai, akros po ding in aman uhi.
heading: Jesu Kilhdenna / (Mat 27.32-44; Luk 23.26-43; Joh 19.17-27)
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

paite: Golgotha mun ah Jesu api ua, huai tuh Luguh Mun, chihna ahi.
english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

paite: Huan uain murrah toh hel apia ua, himahleh adawn nuam kei.
english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

paite: Akilhden ua, atan ding chiat uh theihna ding in aisan in apuansilhte akihawm uhi.
english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

paite: Akilhden hun uh dak thumna vel ahi.
english: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

paite: Ahekna lai atunglam ah agelh ua, "JUDATE' KUMPIPA,” chi in.
english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

paite: Huan suamhat nih, ataklam ah khat, aveilam ah khat amah toh akilhden uhi.
english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

paite: Laisiangthou in, "Amah talekte toh simkhawm ahita," chih genna hihtangtun in a-omta hi.
english: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

paite: Huan mi kivialleh peuh in alu uh sing in, "Ehe! Nang tempul susia a ni thum a lam nawnpa,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

paite: Kihondam inla, kros a kipan hong kum in," chi in a-enghou uhi.
english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

paite: Huchi mah bang in siampu liante'n, laigelhmite toh, amau lak a enghou in, "Midang bawn hondam a, amah kihondam theiloupi in," achi uh.
english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

paite: I muh a, i gintak theihna ding in, "Khrist, Israel Kumpipa, tu in kros a kipan hong kumleh akei dia," achi uhi. Huan amah toh akilhden samte'n leng a-enghou uhi.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

paite: Huan dak gukna ahong hih in, dak kuana dong in gam pumpi ahong mialta hi.
heading: Jesu Sihna / (Mat 27.45-56; Luk 23.44-49; Joh 19.28-31)
english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

paite: Dak kuana ding in aw ngaihtak in Jesu, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?" chi in akikoukhia a, huai tuh, "Ka Pathian, Ka Pathian, bang achia hon paisan?" chihna ahi.
english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

paite: Huan akiang a dingh khenkhatte'n huai azak un, "Ngai un, Elijah sam ahi," achi uh.
english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

paite: Mi khat atai a, uain thuk spanji diahdim in, chiangdawn ah atak a, adawnsak hi. "Khawl dih ua, amah lakhe ding in Elijah ahong hiam i en ding uh," achi uhi.
english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

paite: Aw ngaihtak in Jesu akikou a, akha akhahta hi.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

paite: Tempul puanzak atunglam a kipan anuailam pha in ahong keksuakta hi.
english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

paite: Amazawn a sepaih zaheutupa dingh in huchibang a akha akhah amuh in, “Hiai mi zaw Pathian Tapa ahi ngeingei," achi hi.
english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

paite: Numeite'n leng gamlatak a dingh in a-en ua; huaite lak ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob naupangzaw leh Joses nu Mari, Salomi leng apang uhi.
english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

paite: Huaite Galili gam a a-om lai a, amah zui a, a-nna sepsak zelte ahi uhi; numei dang tampi Jerusalem a amah toh hohtoute leng a-om uhi.
english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahih in Kisakkholhna ahih ziak in, huai Sabbath ma ni ahi,
heading: Jesu Vuina / (Mat 27.57-61; Luk 23.50-56; Joh 19.38-42)
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

paite: Arimathai a om, Joseph, vaihawmpa zahtakhuai, Pathian lalgam lamenmi, ahong pai a, hangsantak in Pilat kiang ah alut a, Jesu luang angenta hi.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

paite: Huchi in Pilat in huchibang a asih pah lamdang asa mahmah a, huchi in sepaih zaheutupa sam in, asihna asawtta hiam chih adong hi.
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

paite: Sepaih zaheutupa kam a pan sita ahi chih atheih in, Joseph kiang ah aluang apia hi.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

paite: Huan ama'n puanmalngat alei a, amah alakhia a, puanmalngat in atuam a, han khuakkuak ah asial a, suang in han kong adelhta hi.
english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

paite: Huan Mari Magdalin leh Joses nu Mari in asialna amu uhi.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.
